data.body: EPIC 9109 CLOSED - the whole tree is done. Closing sequence after the operator chose (a): amended B's AC5 -> that invalidated B's plan-review attestation ('stale-material') -> fresh review-plan on B PASSED (0 blocking) -> B CLOSED. Closing the epic then hit 'stale-pin-drift' because an epic's attestation pins its children's material and B's description had changed; amended the epic's AC5 identically (same operator decision), re-reviewed -> PASS (0 blocking). The completion verifier then refused the epic once more, correctly, on the 'make lint/typecheck/FULL make test pass' AC - the epic carried no comment recording those runs. Added the concrete gate evidence (four local full-suite runs incl. the one that legitimately FAILED 7664/1 and was fixed, plus the four GitHub Actions Verified runs by change number) and the close then succeeded. FINAL STATE: epic closed; all four stories closed; all four changes merged on main (1016, 1017, 1024, 1025), each at LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 with 0 unresolved; scaffolding ticket 4b14 archived with a do-not-implement note; merge-check worktree removed; /Users/joeoakhart/rebar-serena-default left clean at the merged tip 36411da47.
